bead.title: opencode: rewrite stream parser to consume real --format json JSONL events
bead.description:
PROBLEM: internal/harnesses/opencode/stream.go:52 (parseOpencodeStream) buffers ALL of `opencode run --format json` stdout and emits it as a single text_delta, then parses usage from opencodeUsage/opencodeEnvelope structs (stream.go:21-32) whose fields (usage.input_tokens, total_cost_usd) DO NOT EXIST in real output. Verified against opencode 1.3.17: `--format json` emits newline-delimited JSON events, e.g. {"type":"text","part":{"type":"text","text":"PONG"}} and {"type":"step_finish","part":{"type":"step-finish","tokens":{"total":13526,"input":13505,"output":3,"reasoning":18,"cache":{"write":0,"read":0}},"cost":0}}. Result: FinalText is raw JSONL (not the model's answer), no per-message text deltas, usage always absent.

ROOT CAUSE: stream.go:52-148 (buffer-and-blob design) + stream.go:21-32 (fictional envelope structs).

PROPOSED FIX: Rewrite parseOpencodeStream to scan line-by-line, MIRRORING internal/harnesses/codex/stream.go parseCodexStream (codex/stream.go:77-192). Per line, unmarshal into a new opencodeStreamEvent{Type string; Part struct{Type,Text,Tool,CallID string; State json.RawMessage; Tokens *opencodeTokens; Cost float64}}. Map type=="text"/part.type=="text" -> EventTypeTextDelta (accumulate into agg.FinalText); type=="step_finish" -> record part.tokens (input/output/reasoning, cache.read/write) + part.cost into the aggregate; type=="error" -> return error from part/error.data.message (keep existing opencodeErrorMessage shape, stream.go:151). Extend streamAggregate to carry input/output/reasoning/cache token counts. Leave tool_use handling to the dependent tool-events bead.

NON-SCOPE: tool_call/tool_result emission (separate bead); usage ResolveFinalUsage wiring (separate bead). Do not change runner arg construction.
bead.acceptance:
1. Add fixture internal/harnesses/opencode/testdata/jsonl/text_only.jsonl with the verified 3-line text run (step_start; text="PONG"; step_finish tokens input=13505/output=3/reasoning=18, cost=0).
2. New Test TestParseOpencodeStream_RealJSONL: exactly one text_delta with Text=="PONG", agg.FinalText=="PONG", aggregate input=13505 output=3.
3. New Test TestParseOpencodeStream_StepFinishUsage: the step_finish tokens map (input/output/reasoning, cache read/write) is captured into the aggregate.
4. New Test TestParseOpencodeStream_ErrorEventInStream: a 2-line stream (one text, then {"type":"error",...,"error":{"data":{"message":"Model not found"}}}) makes the parser return an error containing "Model not found".
5. Remove the obsolete opencodeUsage/opencodeEnvelope structs (stream.go:21-32).
6. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS ~600s on live-network ListModels tests).
7. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
